---
title: "Analytics modeling, from the ground up"
subtitle: "Seventeen lessons. In each one you do the idea by hand, then teach it to a computer."
---

This is a free guide to how data is turned into predictions and decisions. It starts from arithmetic and assumes nothing else.

Every lesson works the same way. You are asked a question and you answer it by doing something: planting a flag, dragging a line, sliding a number. Then you write a few lines of Python that do what you just did, on the same data, and the page draws what your code computed. Only at the end are you told what the method is called.

You do not need to install anything. The Python runs in this page.

## Lessons {#chapters}

::: {.chapter-list}

### Foundations

What data looks like as points, and the one idea every method shares: make a guess, measure how wrong it is, make it better.

- [Points and distance](points-and-distance.qmd) How do you measure how alike two things are?
- [A better guess](a-better-guess.qmd) How do you know one guess is better than another?

### Predicting a number

- [Fitting a line](regression-from-scratch.qmd) Which line misses the points least?
- [Choosing what to keep](variable-selection-from-scratch.qmd) Which measurements actually help?

### Sorting into classes

- [Nearest neighbours](knn-from-scratch.qmd) What do the closest examples say?
- [The widest gap](svm-from-scratch.qmd) Where should the dividing line go?
- [Decision trees](cart-from-scratch.qmd) Which question should you ask first?

### Trusting a model

- [Testing on unseen data](cross-validation-from-scratch.qmd) How do you know it will work next time?

### Finding structure

- [Finding groups](kmeans-from-scratch.qmd) How do you find groups nobody labelled?
- [Reshaping data](pca-boxcox-from-scratch.qmd) Can the same data be looked at from a better angle?
- [Missing values](missing-data-from-scratch.qmd) What do you do about the holes?

### Data over time

- [Spotting a change](cusum-from-scratch.qmd) How do you catch the moment something shifted?
- [Forecasting](time-series-from-scratch.qmd) What comes next in a series?

### Deciding

- [Running an experiment](doe-from-scratch.qmd) What should you test when the data does not exist yet?
- [Simulating chance](simulation-markov-from-scratch.qmd) Why is there a queue when the server can keep up?
- [The best plan](optimization-from-scratch.qmd) How do you choose when everything has a limit?
- [Beyond the basics](advanced-topics-from-scratch.qmd) What else is out there?

:::
